name: video-text
title: Video Text
description: A component that displays text with a video playing in the background.

props.name: text
props.description: The text the video plays inside. When omitted, the plain-text content of the default slot is used (Magic UI's `children`).

props.name: class
props.description: Classes for the container. It fills its parent (`size-full`), so size the parent.

props.name: autoPlay
props.description: Start playing as soon as possible.

props.name: muted
props.description: Mute the video (browsers only autoplay muted video).

props.name: loop
props.description: Restart the video when it ends.

props.name: preload
props.description: How much of the video to preload.

props.name: fontSize
props.description: Font size of the text mask. Numbers are read as `vw`, relative to the mask box.

props.name: fontWeight
props.description: Font weight of the text mask.

props.name: fontFamily
props.description: Font family of the text mask.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Plain text to cut out of the video, used when the `text` prop is not set.
